ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 45% high-intensity white to 55% low-intensity black/dark-blue, characterized by large central white patches surrounded by dark peripheral pigmentation.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Two primary high-intensity regions: a large, roughly trapezoidal white block on the left lobe's medial-lower quadrant and a segmented, heavily streaked white patch on the right lobe's central-medial area. The transition to the dark trailing edge is defined by dense, vertical black-to-white 'combed' or streaked pixel gradients.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Distinct V-shaped notch with an estimated interior angle of 75 degrees; the depth is approximately 1/8th of the total lobe height from the leading edge baseline.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous, high-frequency micro-scalloping along the entire trailing edge. Visible peaks and valleys exhibit an average amplitude of 3-5 pixels at the provided resolution, with higher irregularity observed on the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetric convex curves extending from the median notch to the lateral tips, with the right lobe displaying a slightly more pronounced upward sweep at the distal end.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular, low-intensity pixel clusters (dark spots) located in the lower-left white field; several high-intensity (white) circular impressions visible near the bottom edge of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Dense array of parallel, vertically-oriented dark linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) crossing the white ventral fields on both lobes, most prominent on the right side.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A significant localized cluster of high-intensity, yellowish-white pixel formations consistent with barnacle colonization is present on the extreme right lateral tip of the fluke.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced 'combed' effect where dark pigment bleeds into white fields in fine parallel lines, creating a high-frequency alternating intensity pattern.
